mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_order(user_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, pay_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{payUrl}, #{payTime}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT') order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
update pay_order set status = #{status}, pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select order_id as orderId from pay_order where status = "PAY_WAIT" and now() >= order_time + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE order by id ASC limit 50
select order_id as orderId from pay_order where status = "PAY_WAIT" and now() >= order_time + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE order by id ASC limit 10
